name: StackWC Custom Permalinks for WooCommerce
author: StackWC

sections.description:
Custom Permalinks for WooCommerce helps store owners create short, readable, search-friendly WooCommerce URLs without complex code.

Whether you want /product-name, /category/product-name, /shop/category/product-name, or SKU-based URLs, this plugin gives you practical controls to match your SEO strategy and store structure.

Perfect for:

  • WooCommerce stores migrating to cleaner URLs
  • SEO-focused stores that want consistent URL structures
  • Merchants who need product-level permalink control
  • Teams that want easier URL management without custom development

Free Features

  • Global WooCommerce product permalink structure controls
  • Global product category permalink structure controls
  • Remove product base where applicable
  • Remove category base where applicable
  • Works with WooCommerce permalink settings and routing
  • Compatible with modern WordPress and WooCommerce versions

Pro Features

  • Per-product permalink structure selection from product edit sidebar
  • Per-product custom permalink path support
  • Product slug only URLs on selected products
  • Product with category URLs on selected products
  • Full path product URLs on selected products
  • Replace product slug with SKU on selected products
  • Add optional URL suffixes (for example .html)
  • Automatic rewrite refresh when:
    • product permalink structure changes
    • custom product permalink changes
    • product SKU changes
  • Better handling of .html (and other suffix) URLs across global and per-product rules
  • Canonical redirect compatibility to reduce duplicate URL issues

SEO Benefits

  • Clean URLs improve click-through and user trust
  • Consistent permalink patterns help crawl efficiency
  • Reduced duplicate URL risk with canonical-friendly behavior
  • Easier URL migration planning for category and product pages
  • Supports readable, keyword-friendly product paths
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/stackwc-custom-permalinks-for-woocommerce directory, or install via WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Custom Permalinks.
  4. Choose product and category permalink structures.
  5. Configure optional URL suffix and advanced settings.
  6. Save settings and regenerate permalinks.

sections.faq:
Is this plugin SEO friendly?

Yes. The plugin is designed for SEO-friendly WooCommerce URLs with clean structures, optional suffixes, and better canonical behavior for custom permalink routes.

Does it support WooCommerce default permalink settings?

Yes. You can keep WooCommerce default structures or switch to custom structures. The plugin is built to work with WooCommerce permalink bases.

Can I set permalink structure per product?

Yes (Pro). From the single product edit sidebar, you can choose structure options such as product slug only, product with category, full path, or SKU-based URL.

Does `.html` suffix work for products and categories?

Yes. You can enable URL suffix support (for example .html) and apply it to products and/or categories from settings.

What happens when I change a product SKU?

For SKU-based product URLs (Pro), rewrite refresh is scheduled automatically after SKU change so new SKU URLs can resolve without manual permalink save.

Will changing permalinks affect my existing SEO?

Any URL change can affect SEO if old URLs are not redirected. Plan permalink changes carefully, update internal links, and use redirects where needed.

  • Integrated with Freemius for licensing and updates
  • UI improvements and styling updates
  • Improved rewrite handling for WooCommerce default and custom product/category URL structures
  • Improved optional URL suffix routing behavior (including .html) across product and category URLs
  • Fixed per-product custom structure URL resolution for:
    • Product slug only
    • Product with category
    • Full path
    • SKU-based product URLs
  • Added automatic rewrite refresh scheduling on:
    • single product permalink structure change
    • single product custom permalink change
    • product SKU change
  • Improved reliability so permalink changes apply without manual permalink settings save in common flows

1.0.0

  • Initial release
